layerRules.outerwear: Masks top torso, sleeves, hood and collar; outer garment includes its own construction. Keep top hem only if not clipping.
layerRules.headwear: Use fitted-hair collection, preserves lower fringe. Bun/ponytail portions above the band are compressed into the crown.
layerRules.neck: Headphones and necklace share a slot. Headphones are neck-worn to accommodate every hairstyle.
layerRules.back: Long rear hair uses a shoulder-length compressed back volume to clear backpack.
layerRules.prop: Independent meter-based props, default origin at supporting surface; only hand-size props may use hand.R mount.

bodyMasks.headAndHands: Preserve original head and hands. Harper fitted master uses a neutral mirrored left hand when not carrying books.
